Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent), molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary (child), compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno. Join child molecule_dictionary on molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno. Join compound_structures on child.molregno. Join compound_records on child.molregno. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id. Join activities on compound_records.record_id. Join assays on activities.assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid. Filter: parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2105717'. Include parent row by joining molecule_hierarchy where parent_molregno = parent.molregno OR molregno = parent.molregno. target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717'. activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
